description.fragment: The best homemade chocolate chip cookies with a crispy edge and chewy center.

ingredients.fragment: <c><f>Dry Ingredients</f><k><h>2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour</h><h>1 tsp baking soda</h><h>1 tsp salt</h></k><f>Wet Ingredients</f><k><h>1 cup butter, softened</h><h>3/4 cup granulated sugar</h><h>3/4 cup packed brown sugar</h><h>2 large eggs</h><h>2 tsp vanilla extract</h><h>2 cups chocolate chips</h></k></c>

instructions.fragment: <c><f>Preparation:</f><j><h>Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).</h><h>Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.</h><h>Beat butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar in large mixer bowl until creamy.</h><h>Add eggs and vanilla extract; beat well.</h><h>Gradually beat in flour mixture.</h><h>Stir in chocolate chips.</h><h>Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets.</h><h>Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.</h><h>Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.</h></j></c>

recipes.name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: The best homemade chocolate chip cookies with a crispy edge and chewy center.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl.
Beat butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar in large mixer bowl until creamy.
Add eggs and vanilla extract; beat well.
Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes; remove to wire racks to cool completely.
